project_analysis.summary: hindustaan.in is an online platform providing various services including travel, food, and entertainment. It appears to be a multi-component web application with a focus on user convenience and accessibility.
project_analysis.main_purpose: To provide a one-stop solution for travel, food, and entertainment services to users in India.
expected_user_journey: User visits the homepage and navigates through different sections (Travel, Food, Entertainment).
Users search for specific services (e.g., flights, restaurants) and book them.
Users make payments and receive confirmation.

smoke_tests: Verify that the homepage loads successfully.
Check if all main navigation links are functional.
Ensure that search functionality works for services like flights and restaurants.
regression_tests: Test booking a flight from the Travel section.
Validate placing an order at a restaurant in the Food section.
Confirm that entertainment tickets can be booked through the Entertainment section.
boundary_tests: Check if search results are displayed correctly for edge cases (e.g., very low or high prices).
Test booking services with the minimum and maximum allowed quantities.
negative_tests: Attempt to book a service without providing required details.
Try placing an order with invalid payment information.
Check if error messages are displayed correctly for failed bookings.
accessibility_tests: Audit the website for compliance with WCAG 2.1 standards.
Ensure that all interactive elements are keyboard accessible.
integration_tests: Verify integration between booking systems and payment gateways.
Check if data is correctly synchronized across different services (e.g., travel, food).
system_tests: Test the system under load to ensure it can handle peak traffic times.
Validate that all critical components are up and running simultaneously.
ui_tests: Check for visual consistency across different pages and sections.
Ensure that UI elements (e.g., buttons, forms) are responsive and visually appealing.
functional_tests: Verify the functionality of booking services (flights, restaurants, entertainment).
Test the payment process to ensure transactions are processed correctly.
exploratory_tests: Explore user interactions with different sections of the website.
Identify any unexpected behaviors or issues during user navigation.
compatibility_tests: Test the website on multiple browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
Ensure compatibility across different devices (desktops, tablets, smartphones).
security_tests: Perform a security audit to identify vulnerabilities.
Check for secure transmission of user data during transactions.
performance_test_suggestions: Use benchmarks like TTFB (Time To First Byte) and LCP (Largest Contentful Paint).
Test the website's performance under simulated high traffic conditions.
api_test_suggestions: Load test API endpoints related to booking services.
Check for rate limiting and error handling in API responses.
